description: Repairs r-wire/ado-command-parameters: rows 202, 203, 302 and 303 held the previous row's value after a failed Parameter put, so Execute stored a stale value. On a read-write copy of r-wire-blank (ACE OLE DB connection), for each of FInt i4-32768 (202) and i4-minus32769 (203), FLong r8-2147483648 (302) and r8-minus2147483649 (303): a fresh ADODB.Command INSERT INTO W (ID, column) VALUES (?, ?) with fresh CreateParameter pI (adInteger) and pV (adSmallInt for FInt, adInteger for FLong), each Value put and read back, Execute with adExecuteNoRecords, Connection.Errors read and cleared right after. Then FInt and FLong are read through client static read-only recordsets (field metadata, GetRows). Asks per cell the HRESULT and error of the put and Execute, the read-back, and the stored tag and value or absence.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
